name: EncounterClassR6
description: Backport of the R6 Encounter `class` search to R4. R6 `Encounter.class` is a list of CodeableConcepts; an R4 Encounter holds one native Coding and keeps any further classes in the cross-version extension http://hl7.org/fhir/6.0/StructureDefinition/extension-Encounter.class. This parameter matches the native class or any Coding of that extension, the same Encounters that R6 `class` finds. R4 `class` keeps its standard meaning (native Coding only), so the backport has its own code. Cannot be combined with `class` in one request.
